requirements.subject: successive advance warning signs
requirements.threshold: 100 ft minimum between each successive sign in the urban low-speed category
applicability_conditions: A series of two or more advance warning signs is used
Posted speed is 20 mph and the roadway is urban low-speed
required_inputs: Measured longitudinal distances between successive advance warning signs
requirements.source_span: Table 6B-1. Recommended Advance Warning Sign Minimum Spacing. Urban (low speed): 100 feet, 100 feet, 100 feet. Urban (high speed): 350 feet, 350 feet, 350 feet. Rural: 500 feet, 500 feet, 500 feet. Expressway / Freeway: 1,000 feet, 1,500 feet, 2,640 feet. The column headings A, B, and C are the dimensions shown in Figures 6P-1 through 6P-54.
missing_inputs: Measured longitudinal distances between successive advance warning signs
requirements.planned_evidence_strategy: Inspect temporally separated sign candidates to establish independent signs, then measure or project their longitudinal positions along the roadway and calculate every successive spacing.
requirements.planned_decision_rule: If a qualifying series is confirmed, pass only when every successive spacing is at least 100 ft; if the series or spacing cannot be resolved, report insufficient evidence.

requirements.subject: tangent channelizing devices
requirements.relation: should be spaced no farther apart than
requirements.threshold: 2 times the posted speed limit in feet; at 20 mph, 40 ft maximum
applicability_conditions: Channelizing devices are used in a tangent section
required_inputs: Measured spacing between successive tangent channelizing devices
requirements.source_span: The spacing between cones, tubular markers, vertical panels, drums, and barricades should not exceed a distance in feet equal to 1 times the speed limit in mph when used for taper channelization, and should not exceed a distance in feet equal to 2 times the speed limit in mph when used for tangent channelization.
missing_inputs: Measured spacing between successive tangent channelizing devices
requirements.planned_evidence_strategy: Identify successive independent devices in the tangent section from accepted observations and temporal views, then audit their longitudinal spacing using trajectory and calibrated geometry as needed.
requirements.planned_decision_rule: At 20 mph, pass only if no tangent spacing exceeds 40 ft; any supported exceedance fails, while unresolved device identity or geometry is insufficient.

requirements.subject: channelizing devices
requirements.threshold: serviceable; devices no longer serviceable shall be replaced
applicability_conditions: Channelizing devices are deployed in the inspected TTC zone
required_inputs: Visual inspection of deployed channelizing devices for serviceability
requirements.source_span: Channelizing devices that are no longer serviceable (see definition in Section 1C.02) shall be replaced.
missing_inputs: Visual inspection of deployed channelizing devices for serviceability
requirements.planned_evidence_strategy: Inspect close, well-lit temporal views of the deployed cones, drums, and delineators for damage, displacement, contamination, and visibility.
requirements.planned_decision_rule: Pass only if all inspected deployed channelizing devices are serviceable; any supported non-serviceable device fails, and obscured devices remain insufficient.

requirements.planned_evidence_strategy: Inspect representative temporal images of each deployed channelizer type for size, color, stripe pattern, retroreflection, and placement characteristics.
requirements.planned_decision_rule: Pass only for characteristics supported by visible evidence across applicable device types; obscured or unresolvable characteristics are insufficient.

requirements.candidate_label: SEC-6H.03 01: The ROAD (STREET) WORK (W20-1) sign (see Figure 6H-1), which serves as a general warning of obstructions or restrictions
requirements.subject: The ROAD (STREET) WORK (W20-1) sign (see Figure 6H-1), which serves as a general warning of obstructions or restrictions,
requirements.threshold: The ROAD (STREET) WORK (W20-1) sign (see Figure 6H-1), which serves as a general warning of obstructions or restrictions, should be located in advance of the work space or any detour, on the road where the work is taking place.
requirements.source_span: The ROAD (STREET) WORK (W20-1) sign (see Figure 6H-1), which serves as a general warning of obstructions or restrictions, should be located in advance of the work space or any detour, on the road where the work is taking place.

measurement_spec.quantity: distance from ROAD WORK sign to work space or any detour

thresholds.condition: sign is not in advance of work space or detour

requirements.planned_evidence_strategy: Inspect each visible ROAD WORK sign and locate the work space or detour, then measure their longitudinal ordering along the roadway.
requirements.planned_decision_rule: Pass only when the ROAD WORK sign is demonstrated to be upstream of the work space or any detour on the work road; unresolved work-space location is insufficient.

requirements.candidate_label: SEC-6B.05 02: Except for mobile operations, when redirection of the road users’ normal path is required, road users
requirements.subject: Except for mobile operations, when redirection of the road users’ normal path is required, road users
requirements.threshold: Except for mobile operations, when redirection of the road users’ normal path is required, road users shall be directed from the normal path to a new path with appropriate channelizing devices, traffic control devices, and/or TTC methods.
requirements.source_span: Except for mobile operations, when redirection of the road users’ normal path is required, road users shall be directed from the normal path to a new path with appropriate channelizing devices, traffic control devices, and/or TTC methods.
requirements.planned_evidence_strategy: Inspect the approach and transition to verify that the normal path is redirected to the open path using appropriate channelizing devices, traffic control devices, or TTC methods, excluding mobile operations.
requirements.planned_decision_rule: Pass only if the complete observed redirection is visibly supported by appropriate devices or methods; otherwise report failure or insufficient evidence as visibility permits.

requirements.candidate_label: SEC-6K.06 01: Drums (see Figure 6K-1) used for road user warning or channelization
requirements.subject: Drums (see Figure 6K-1) used for road user warning or channelization
requirements.threshold: Drums (see Figure 6K-1) used for road user warning or channelization shall be constructed of lightweight, deformable materials. They shall be a minimum of 36 inches in height and have at least an 18-inch minimum width regardless of orientation. Metal drums shall not be used. The markings on drums shall be horizontal, circumferential, alternating orange and white retroreflective stripes 4 to 6 inches wide. Each drum shall have a minimum of two orange and two white stripes with the top stripe being orange. Any non-retroreflectorized spaces between the horizontal orange and white stripes shall not exceed 3 inches wide. Drums shall have closed tops that will not allow collection of construction debris or other debris.
requirements.source_span: Drums (see Figure 6K-1) used for road user warning or channelization shall be constructed of lightweight, deformable materials. They shall be a minimum of 36 inches in height and have at least an 18-inch minimum width regardless of orientation. Metal drums shall not be used. The markings on drums shall be horizontal, circumferential, alternating orange and white retroreflective stripes 4 to 6 inches wide. Each drum shall have a minimum of two orange and two white stripes with the top stripe being orange. Any non-retroreflectorized spaces between the horizontal orange and white stripes shall not exceed 3 inches wide. Drums shall have closed tops that will not allow collection of construction debris or other debris.
requirements.planned_evidence_strategy: Inspect images for drum identity and markings, and use trajectory and lidar projection where needed to resolve dimensions, material, stripe count and width, top closure, and device orientation.
requirements.planned_decision_rule: Pass only when every applicable drum characteristic is supported; a confirmed noncompliant characteristic fails, while unresolved characteristics remain insufficient.

requirements.subject: directional lane-closure layout
requirements.relation: should conform to the selected TA-19 detour-for-one-travel-direction arrangement
requirements.threshold: opposing traffic is prohibited from the closed direction, the open direction remains available to road users, and the closed direction is routed to an off-site detour
applicability_conditions: TA-19 is the selected applicable layout
One travel direction is closed while the other remains open
required_inputs: Observed lane-closure routing and channelizer layout
requirements.source_span: This plan should be used for streets without posted route numbers.
missing_inputs: Observed lane-closure routing and channelizer layout
requirements.planned_evidence_strategy: Inspect the channelized closure and open ego-direction path across temporal frames, and compare the observed directional routing with TA-19.
requirements.planned_decision_rule: Pass only if the closed direction is prohibited and routed off-site, the other direction remains available, and observed channelization conforms to the selected TA-19 arrangement.

requirements.candidate_label: SEC-6H.01 04: Except as provided in Paragraph 5 of this Section, TTC warning signs
requirements.subject: Except as provided in Paragraph 5 of this Section, TTC warning signs
requirements.threshold: Except as provided in Paragraph 5 of this Section, TTC warning signs shall be diamond-shaped with a black legend and border on an orange background, except for the Grade Crossing Advance Warning (W10-1) sign, which shall have a black legend and border on a yellow background.
requirements.source_span: Except as provided in Paragraph 5 of this Section, TTC warning signs shall be diamond-shaped with a black legend and border on an orange background, except for the Grade Crossing Advance Warning (W10-1) sign, which shall have a black legend and border on a yellow background.
requirements.planned_evidence_strategy: Inspect all visible TTC warning signs in representative temporal images for diamond shape and prescribed colors, treating any grade-crossing exception separately.
requirements.planned_decision_rule: Pass only when each applicable TTC warning sign meets the specified shape and color requirements; obscured signs are insufficient.

requirements.subject: Particular attention
requirements.threshold: Particular attention should be given to maintaining the channelizing devices to keep them clean, visible, and properly positioned at all times.
requirements.source_span: Particular attention should be given to maintaining the channelizing devices to keep them clean, visible, and properly positioned at all times.
requirements.planned_evidence_strategy: Inspect representative close temporal views for cleanliness, visibility, and proper positioning of each deployed channelizing device.
requirements.planned_decision_rule: Pass only when inspected devices are clean, visible, and properly positioned; any supported defect fails, and obscured devices remain insufficient.

requirements.candidate_label: SEC-6H.02 02: Where multiple advance warning signs are needed on the approach to a transition and activity area, the ROAD WORK AHEAD (
requirements.subject: Where multiple advance warning signs are needed on the approach to a transition and activity area, the ROAD WORK AHEAD (W20-1) sign
requirements.threshold: Where multiple advance warning signs are needed on the approach to a transition and activity area, the ROAD WORK AHEAD (W20-1) sign should be the first advance warning sign encountered by road users.
requirements.source_span: Where multiple advance warning signs are needed on the approach to a transition and activity area, the ROAD WORK AHEAD (W20-1) sign should be the first advance warning sign encountered by road users.
requirements.planned_evidence_strategy: Review the approach chronologically and identify the first independent advance-warning sign encountered before the transition or activity area, then classify its legend.
requirements.planned_decision_rule: Pass only if ROAD WORK AHEAD is the first advance-warning sign in a confirmed multi-sign approach; otherwise report noncompliance or insufficient evidence.
